item.title: State College School Board Approves Final Design, Hears Budget Update for New Park Forest Middle School
item.description: State College Area School District's planning for a new Park Forest Middle School moved forward on Monday night with board approval of final designs for a project that is now estimated to cost up to $152 million. The district plans to construct the new 270,000-square-foot, three-story building on Little Lion Drive in Patton Township. item.title: $1M in Federal Funding to Support Radio Upgrades for Emergency Personnel Across Centre County
item.description: Centre County will receive $1 million in federal funding to support the replacement and upgrade of emergency radio equipment for first responders throughout the county, the Board of Commissioners announced on Tuesday. The money will "kickstart" the project to provide approximately 1,400 new mobile and portable radios to fire, EMS and police agencies, Centre County Deputy Administrator Natalie Corman said. item.title: Frank: It’s Bye-Bye Bezos for This Consumer
item.description: We’re done, Jeff. For a while, I found you irresistible. Anything I wanted, you’d bring it to my door, sometimes within 24 hours. I needed to send a gift, you’d do it for me: no trip to the mall, no wrapping or packing, no waiting in line at the post office. item.title: Shaq’s Big Chicken Opens in Downtown State College
item.description: A fast-casual restaurant chain founded by Shaquille O'Neal is ready to celebrate the grand opening of its new State College location. item.description: Updated 10:13 p.m. Feb. 4. item.title: Milesburg Water Authority Plans Temporary Shutoff for Repair
item.description: Customers of the Milesburg Borough Water Authority will be without water service for a period of time on Saturday. Repair work for a leak will require a full system shutdown beginning at 8 a.m. Saturday, according to a statement on the authority's website and Facebook page. "At this time, we do not have an estimated completion time," the authority wrote. "Crews will be working until the repair is finished and service can be safely restored."
